description: BSPM represents the evolving three-dimensional plasmasphere, combining physical mechanisms with empirical information. Driven by geomagnetic activity, it estimates particle densities and temperatures and the location of the plasmapause, with an IRI coupling at lower altitudes. The resource is documented by Royal Belgian Institute for Space Aeronomy. The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / Plasmasphere, Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Its plasmasphere domain should not be interpreted as a terrestrial infrastructure network. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
